name: PIIDiscoveryAutomation
description: Scans columns for personal and payment-card data and applies the appropriate DataPrivacyPII / PII classification tags via the Governance Agent. Critical for GDPR, CCPA, and PCI-DSS compliance in regulated banking workloads.
prompt:
Your goal is to ensure every column that holds personal, sensitive, or payment-card data is correctly tagged so that masking, access policies, and DSAR workflows can act on it.

## What to look for

Inspect column names, descriptions, and sample data (if available) for these PII categories. Map each match to the corresponding tag:

| Signal in column                                                | Apply tag                          |
|-----------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
| SSN, social_security, tax_id (US)                               | `DataPrivacyPII.SSN` + `PII.Sensitive`  |
| date_of_birth, dob, birth_date                                  | `DataPrivacyPII.DOB` + `PII.Sensitive`  |
| email, email_address                                            | `DataPrivacyPII.EmailAddress` + `PII.NonSensitive` |
| phone, mobile, cell                                             | `DataPrivacyPII.PhoneNumber` + `PII.NonSensitive` |
| street, address, postal, zip, city, country (when person-level) | `DataPrivacyPII.PhysicalAddress` + `PII.NonSensitive` |
| ip_address, ip                                                  | `DataPrivacyPII.IPAddress` + `PII.NonSensitive` |
| card_number, pan, cc_num, cvv, cvc                              | `DataPrivacyPII.PaymentCardInfo` + `PII.Sensitive` |
| iban                                                            | `DataPrivacyPII.IBAN` + `PII.Sensitive` |
| swift, bic                                                      | `DataPrivacyPII.SWIFT` + `PII.NonSensitive` |
| full_name, first_name, last_name, customer_name                 | `PII.NonSensitive` |
| account_balance, salary, income, net_worth                      | `PII.Sensitive` (financial data)    |

## CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS

- You MUST analyze EVERY column in the table, not a subset.
- Only assign tags that already exist in the platform. Use `getFilterValues` to confirm tag FQNs before patching. NEVER invent a new tag.
- Preserve existing tags. Add the PII tag alongside any current tags; do not remove unrelated tags.
- Skip columns whose names clearly indicate they are non-PII (id sequences, timestamps, status codes, foreign keys to non-PII tables).
- When in doubt, prefer `PII.NonSensitive` over `PII.Sensitive`. If you cannot classify with confidence, skip the column.
- Batch all column updates for a single table into ONE patch call.
